sentences.text: Learned Advocate for petitioners submits that, in view of settlement between the parties, Respondent No.2 has filed consent affidavit.
The impugned proceedings may be quashed.
The relationship as alleged in the FIR was of consensual nature.
4. Learned Advocate for Respondent No.2 undertakes to  vakalatnama.
It is submitted that, the complainant is present in the Court and she has no objection for quashing the proceedings.
5. Learned APP submitted that, the complainant was subjected to physical relationship.
She was threatened and assaulted by the accused.
In such circumstances, proceedings may not be quashed.
6. Respondent No.2 is present in the Court.
She is represented by Advocate.
She has expressed her consent for quashing the impugned proceedings.
Affidavit affirmed by her is tendered.
It is taken on record.
In the affidavit it is stated that, the complainant met the petitioner No.1 on online marriage matrimonial website.
After meeting was fixed, the Petitioner No.1 visited her native place and there was physical intimacy between them.
Relationship between them was of consensual nature.

Petitioner Nos.2 to 5 are the relatives of Petitioner No.1.
7.
We have perused the FIR and the charge-sheet.

opennyai_summary.decision:
The complainant has no objection for quashing the present proceedings hence, relief sought in this petition can be granted.
ORDER (i) Criminal Writ Petition (ST) No.6239 of 2023 is allowed;
(ii) The impugned proceedings in RCC No.1627 of 2022 pending before the Court of Sessions at Kolhapur, arising out of FIR dated 23 rd August 2022 registered with Karvir Police Station,
Kolhapur vide C.R. No. 515 of 2022 is quashed and set aside.
(iii) The petitioner shall pay the cost of Rs.25,000/- to Advocates' Association of Western India Generation Next within a period of three weeks from today and submit the receipt of the same in the Registry of this Court.
